Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1 Ex22 and p6.1-p6.2. Explicit actual measurable phase-flow defect and positive norm-tail probability are ASTIS bounded elaborations of the source smalltime argument; the full L2 strong-continuity consumer is not claimed.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. This is a bounded ASTIS elaboration of the actual first-event argument in Appendix A.1 Ex22, not a quotation or a proof of the full L² strong-continuity theorem. The inequality uses inclusion in the first-event event, not equality: a bounce or a later return can leave the phase equal to the no-jump flow. All six analytic source hypotheses remain; no first-event law, path, continuity, invariance, nonexplosion, energy or cap certificate is a premise. No uniform parameter limit/nullset or arbitrary correlated random-input substitution is inferred. Full L²/Markov/restart/semigroup/invariance/hypocoercivity/implementation/error/cost/main/composition results remain open.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),

          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n : ℕ, eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) ∧

          ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) ∧
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        Z y xRef z₀ 0 sample = z₀)
 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
          MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ∧
          P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ≤
              1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) ∧
        (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0, MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)))
decoder_context: All displayed functions and objects are literal definitions. The potential is real-valued on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; dimension zero is allowed. The six analytic hypotheses are the only supplied mathematical premises. fderiv is the Frechet derivative, gradient is the real inner-product gradient, and ContDiff real 2 means twice continuously differentiable.

expMeasure 1 is the rate-one exponential measure on the real line. infinitePi is the canonical countable product on all real sequences. toNNReal is max(x,0) viewed as a nonnegative real, including exceptional nonpositive coordinates.

hittingAfter f s 0 a denotes the infimum of nonnegative times at which f(t)(a) belongs to s, with infinity for an empty hit set. WithTop NNReal includes a greatest element top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when finite, and zero at top; the guard branches before evaluating a finite-state update.

Sum.inl stores a finite accumulated time and state pair. Sum.inr Unit is the absorbing stopped record, represented by eventTime top and carrying no state at infinity. Nat.rec initializes at (0,z0) and uses coordinate k in update k to k+1.

Products associate to the right. Measurable means Borel measurable for the displayed finite-dimensional, nonnegative-time and countable product measurable structures. NNReal subtraction is max(t-s,0). A quantified function witness is a total map; no measurable selection or trajectory is supplied as an assumption.

Measure.real is the real value of measure of a set. Product norm on E×E gives its phase topology. Tendsto with nhds0 on NNReal means the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter at0 within nonnegative times; every real delta>0 is quantified.

For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}.   let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>

lesson.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. This is a bounded ASTIS elaboration of the actual first-event argument in Appendix A.1 Ex22, not a quotation or a proof of the full L² strong-continuity theorem. The inequality uses inclusion in the first-event event, not equality: a bounce or a later return can leave the phase equal to the no-jump flow. All six analytic source hypotheses remain; no first-event law, path, continuity, invariance, nonexplosion, energy or cap certificate is a premise. No uniform parameter limit/nullset or arbitrary correlated random-input substitution is inferred. Full L²/Markov/restart/semigroup/invariance/hypocoercivity/implementation/error/cost/main/composition results remain open.
